name: Body
description: A simulation body with shape, material, state, and bound.

attributes.name: groupMask
attributes.description: Bitmask for interaction detection purposes: it is required that two bodies have at least one bit in common in their groupMask for their interaction to be possible from the

attributes.name: flags
attributes.description: Bits of various body-related flags. *Do not access directly*. In c++, use isDynamic/setDynamic, isBounded/setBounded, isAspherical/setAspherical. In python, use

attributes.name: material
attributes.description: Material instance associated with this body.

attributes.name: bound
attributes.description: Bound, approximating volume for the purposes of collision detection.

attributes.name: clumpId
attributes.description: Id of clump this body makes part of; invalid number if not part of clump; see isStandalone, isClump, isClumpMember properties. Not meant to be modified directly from Python, use O.bodies.appendClumped instead.

attributes.name: chain
attributes.description: Returns Id of chain to which the body belongs.

attributes.name: iterBorn
attributes.description: Step number at which the body was added to simulation.

attributes.name: timeBorn
attributes.description: Time at which the body was added to simulation.

attributes.name: dynamic
attributes.description: Whether this body will be moved by forces. (In c++, use Body::isDynamic/Body::setDynamic)

attributes.name: bounded
attributes.description: Whether this body should have Body.bound created. Note that bodies without a bound do not participate in collision detection. (In c++, use Body::isBounded/Body::setBounded)

attributes.name: aspherical
attributes.description: Whether this body has different inertia along principal axes; NewtonIntegrator makes use of this flag to call rotation integration routine for aspherical bodies, which is more expensive.

attributes.name: isStandalone
attributes.description: True if this body is neither clump, nor clump member; false otherwise.

attributes.name: isClumpMember
attributes.description: True if this body is clump member, false otherwise.

attributes.name: isClump
attributes.description: True if this body is clump itself, false otherwise.

methods.name: intrs
methods.description: Return list of all real interactions in which this body participates.

methods.name: updateAttrs
methods.description: Update object attributes from given dictionary
